name: Hiromi Momota
source:
Likes: Ramen, Temples, Freebies, Superheroes 
Dislikes: Popular guys, Crows

A new part-timer at Moonlight Café, he's prone to make mistakes whenever he's around Hana.
But even if he’s young, do not be fooled by apparences.
